verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API that it describes as the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without the web UI. That claim is backed by a public versioned OpenAPI 3.0 spec, a freshness commitment, a version stability guarantee, and a CLI for automating gates and experiments in CI/CD. The probe 404s at docs-site OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is published at api.statsig.com. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that UI-to-API parity is really complete, and endpoint-level evidence for newer surfaces such as product analytics, AI evals/prompts, Warehouse Native, and access management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
Statsig keeps the OpenAPI spec for this API version up-to-date.
Statsig guarantees that each version won't break existing usage
You can integrate the CLI into CI/CD pipelines to automate the management of Feature Gates and Experiments.
